def check_summary_job(job,selection):
    """Match all seven normal ProofUnit fields; never credit a candidate artifact."""
    from swdb.proof import ProofUnit
    source.need(type(job.unit) is ProofUnit and job.unit.candidate is None,'finite TraceUnit admits only a normal summary job; candidate attribution is forbidden')
    unit=job.unit
    source.need(unit.correctness_policy is None,'finite summary cannot borrow a partial/candidate correctness policy')
    source.need(type(selection) is source.Selection and type(unit.contract) is str and unit.contract.startswith('contract.') and unit.function==source.FUNCTION and unit.contract==selection.contract_id
        and unit.contract_sha256==selection.contract_sha256,'exact selected finite summary function/contract required')
    data=selection.library.get(selection.contract_id)
    source.need(type(data) is dict and data.get('kind')=='rewrite_contract' and data.get('id')==unit.contract,'normal rewrite-contract summary subject required; no code-model attribution')
    source.contract_check(selection.library,data)
    portable=data['proof_unit']['source'];raw=source.contracts.pinned(selection.library,portable)
    path=Path(selection.library.resolve(portable))
    source.need(unit.tree==str(path.parent) and type(unit.tree) is str and unit.tree_sha256==source.sha(raw)
        and portable['sha256']==unit.tree_sha256,'finite summary source tree/code pin must match its exact canonical Plan bytes')
    return dict(subject=dict(kind='library_summary',id=unit.contract),source_sha256=unit.tree_sha256,candidate_attribution=False)
